(i) Z[i,j,k] is the order spanned by the units e_a (Lipschitz; 8 units = the extension group Q_8). The order of C + C spanned by its units, Z[1, i, j, ij] = {(z1, z2) in Z[i]^2 : z1 = z2 (mod 2)}, has index 4 in Z[i]^2 and 8 units (the extension group C_4 x C_2 of the table); Z[i]^2 is the maximal order, with 16 units (C_4 x C_4). On Z[1,i,j,ij] the count is B(n) = (1/2) sum_{ab=n} r_2(a) r_2(b) for odd n (multiplication by i exchanges the two odd classes modulo 2 on every odd shell) and is not a convolution of r_2 for even n (B(2) = 0 against 32, B(4) = 16 against 48).
